What if a storm cloud sucked you up?
In 2007, it really happened to a paraglider.
Over Australia, a thunderstorm grabbed her wing.
Updrafts yanked her up like an elevator.
Inside the cloud, everything went dark.
The air dropped to minus fifty degrees.
Too little oxygen... she blacked out.
Her GPS recorded the whole climb.
As high as a passenger jet!
Ice covered her from head to toe.
Then the storm finally let her drop.
She woke up and steered back down.
She landed hours later, frozen... but alive!
So... would you ever fly near a storm?
